data.name: Tisha
data.gender_notes: Tisha is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A Sanskrit name derived from the root 'tish' which means 'new'. This name signifies the beginning of a new journey in life. It is also considered an auspicious name and is associated with good luck and prosperity. The name Tisha carries the meaning “New beginning, auspiciousness” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Tisha usually hope their child will grow to embody new beginning, auspiciousness and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the beginning of a new spiritual journey or the awakening of the inner self.
data.etymology: Tisha belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “New beginning, auspiciousness.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Tisha total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
